news.title: Mizzou-led team selected for U.S. Department of Energy’s inaugural Genesis Mission
First veterinarian completes Mizzou’s innovative mixed animal internship
news.summary_en: Sam Hoover is showing how a new approach to training veterinarians can strengthen the workforce, expand access to care and prepare veterinarians for the demands of mixed animal practice in rural communities.

news.title: Mizzou provides nursing students with hands-on experience beyond the hospital
news.summary_en: Sinclair School of Nursing students strengthened their pediatric nursing skills this summer while providing compassionate, real-world care for participants in the Missouri Scholars Academy.

news.title: Mizzou innovation speeds up detection of deadly tick-borne disease
news.summary_en: Thanks to university researchers, Rocky Mountain spotted fever can now be detected in just 40 minutes, leading to earlier treatment.

news.title: From marathons to triathlons and beyond, Mizzou Tigers go the distance
news.summary_en: Mizzou faculty, staff and alumni are redefining what’s possible through perseverance and Tiger grit.
